name: Diffuse Octree Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that traverses an octree to find the first leaf node with data for each pixel, then computes lighting using a diffuse and Phong model with distance attenuation.
summary: Diffuse Octree Rendering is an image-order raycasting technique that uses coarse-to-fine octree traversal to skip empty space, differing from methods that march through dense voxel grids.
